evidencia_textual: "secuenciacion con Oxford Nanopore Technology... Se observo un predominio de la variante omicron" (00331348-MejiaCalle, p.8); "the JN.1 lineage was detectable from October 2023 to February 2024" (00331348-MejiaCalle, p.51)
refuerzo_pico: "As observed globally, the JN.1 lineage was first detected in wastewater, preceding its appearance in clinical samples by several months. The same phenomenon occurred in our study in Ecuador." (00331348-MejiaCalle, p.51)
nota_contexto: La tesis local documenta muestreo pasivo tipo torpedo, Nanopore y Freyja en PTAR Quitumbe, predominio de omicron y deteccion de JN.1 en aguas antes que en clinica. Contexto respalda plenamente la idea.

evidencia_textual: "the data on circulating lineages in Ecuador, as shown in Figure 14, is only current up to July 15, 2024. Additionally, it remains to be seen whether all researchers involved in genomic surveillance have uploaded their data, which limits the ability to compare" (00331348-MejiaCalle, p.52)
refuerzo_pico: "Our study shows an uneven distribution of genomic surveillance efforts across the Andean countries of Colombia, Ecuador, Peru, and Bolivia." (bruno-2025, p.5)
nota_contexto: MejiaCalle plantea el problema al comparar contra GISAID/CoVariants (datos desactualizados y carga incompleta de secuencias); el contexto respalda la escasez/irregularidad de informacion genomica en Ecuador. Bruno lo generaliza como disparidad regional en LMIC andinos.

evidencia_textual: "SARS-CoV-2 RNA concentration in wastewater successfully tracks regional infection dynamics and provides less biased abundance estimates than clinical testing" (s41586-022-05049-6/Karthikeyan, p.1); "it is also more cost-effective than clinical testing" (s41586-022-05049-6/Karthikeyan, p.7)
refuerzo_pico: "WBS does not suffer from limitations such as selective population sampling bias (i.e., the potential exclusion of members from some disadvantaged classes), does not suffer from testing fatigue and availability, and is not impacted by lags in clinical reporting" (parkins-2023, p.6)
nota_contexto: La idea (menos sesgo poblacional y menor costo que la clinica) esta respaldada literalmente. Correccion: el verbatim de p.7 es "more cost-effective than clinical testing", no "clinical sequencing" como figuraba.

evidencia_textual: Titulos verificados: "Environmental Surveillance for Polioviruses in the Global Polio Eradication Initiative" (asghar-2014, p.1); "Respiratory Syncytial Virus (RSV) RNA in Wastewater Settled Solids Reflects RSV Clinical Positivity Rates" (Hughes, p.1); "Detection of circulating vaccine-derived poliovirus type 2 (cVDPV2) in wastewater samples: a wake-up call" (eurosurv-30-3-1/Bottcher, p.1)
refuerzo_pico: "We compare genomic viral wastewater surveillance by untargeted shotgun deep-sequencing with hybrid-capture enrichment using a human respiratory virus probe panel, as well as WGS of a selection of human pathogenic viruses by targeted PCR amplification, including SARS-CoV-2 and poliovirus." (child-2023, p.3)
nota_contexto: Los tres titulos confirman a RSV y poliovirus como blancos documentados de vigilancia ambiental; Child los enmarca como virus patogenos humanos secuenciados desde aguas. Contexto respalda la idea.

evidencia_textual: "WWS for NPEV and other pathogens represents an inexpensive, flexible, anonymised, reliable, population-based tool for monitoring outbreaks" (microorganisms-11-02496/Bubba, p.1)
refuerzo_pico: "Combining efforts to use modern molecular-based wastewater surveillance for multiple pathogens to complement clinical surveillance will make the systems more cost-efficient and sustainable." (microorganisms-11-02496/Bubba, p.8)
nota_contexto: Bubba describe la WWS como economica y flexible y, en p.8, sostiene que integrar multiples patogenos aumenta costo-eficiencia y sostenibilidad. Contexto respalda la idea.

evidencia_textual: "RSV-WEM dominated (lower costs and higher utilities) RSV-CS and remained unaltered in all scenario analyses." (Mercier_2025, p.2)
refuerzo_pico: "In total, the cost of RSV-WEM was calculated to be CAD$12.31 per infant (infrastructure: CAD$4.07 plus sampling: CAD$8.24)." (Mercier_2025, p.4)
nota_contexto: Estudio canadiense de costo-utilidad: el monitoreo ambiental de RSV dominio a la vigilancia clinica en todos los escenarios, con costo de CAD$12,31 por lactante. Contexto respalda la idea; el escenario es Canada.

evidencia_textual: Titulo: "SARS-CoV-2 genomic surveillance in wastewater as a model for monitoring evolution of endemic viruses" (s41467-023-41369-5/Yousif, p.1)
refuerzo_pico: "wastewater genomics can support SARS-CoV-2 epidemiological investigations by reliably recovering the prevalence of local circulating variants, even when clinical samples are not available." (s41467-023-41369-5/Yousif, p.1)
nota_contexto: Yousif presenta la genomica de aguas como modelo para virus endemicos y afirma la recuperacion de prevalencia de variantes sin muestras clinicas. Contexto respalda plenamente la idea.

evidencia_textual: "We used wastewater RNA concentrations of influenza A and B (IAV/IBV), respiratory syncytial virus (RSV), human metapneumovirus (HMPV), and SARS-CoV-2 from 175 treatment plants (July 2023-June 2024)." (Chan_2025, p.1)
refuerzo_pico: "Epidemic peak dates were consistent with prepandemic norms for all viruses. Peak dates for influenza and RSV coincided with high, upward trending SARS-CoV-2 RNA concentrations" (Chan_2025, p.1)
nota_contexto: Chan sigue conjuntamente influenza A/B, RSV, HMPV y SARS-CoV-2 en un mismo flujo de aguas de 175 plantas, con patrones estacionales. Contexto respalda la idea.

evidencia_textual: "Se utilizo un equipo de muestreo pasivo tipo torpedo para recolectar las muestras... el mismo que se coloco en colectores de aguas residuales de la PTAR Quitumbe, durante 24 horas semanales... secuenciacion con Oxford Nanopore Technology y los datos bioinformaticos fueron analizados en Freyja." (00331348-MejiaCalle, p.8)
refuerzo_pico: "Se observo un predominio de la variante omicron, con linajes como HN.1, EG.5.1.6, XBB.1.5.1.5 y HV.1. En particular, se detecto el linaje JN.1 durante los picos de infeccion en Quito" (00331348-MejiaCalle, p.8)
nota_contexto: El antecedente local documenta muestreo pasivo + Nanopore + Freyja en la PTAR Quitumbe y la deteccion/caracterizacion de variantes de SARS-CoV-2. Contexto respalda la idea del sitio validado.

evidencia_textual: "With the design of a probe panel containing species of interest for WBE, this method could provide an efficient means of monitoring a spectrum of human pathogenic viruses simultaneously." (child-2023, p.2); "complete VP1 sequences of viruses isolated from sewage samples" (asghar-2014, p.7)
refuerzo_pico: Titulo: "Whole-genome nanopore sequencing and automatic downstream analysis of respiratory syncytial virus using RSVTyper... suitable for patient samples as well as wastewater" (s41598-025-20371-5/Le, p.1)
nota_contexto: Existen metodos dirigidos/enriquecimiento (Child, panel de sondas) y protocolos especificos para RSV (Le/RSVTyper, Nanopore, aplicable a aguas) y poliovirus (Asghar, VP1 desde alcantarillado). Contexto respalda la existencia de metodos.

evidencia_textual: Child, Le y Asghar respaldan solo la EXISTENCIA de metodos dirigidos (panel de sondas, RSVTyper, VP1), no un costo cero. Soporte correcto del ahorro: "using existing WEM infrastructure for RSV detection" (Mercier_2025, p.2)
refuerzo_pico: "samples have already been collected and pre-processed for other disease targets at the same site... With the existing sampling infrastructure at the sites, the cost per..." (Mercier_2025, p.4)
nota_contexto: La frase "sin requerir infraestructura ni inversion adicional" excede lo que dicen Child/Le/Asghar (solo prueban que los metodos existen). Mercier respalda "aprovechar la infraestructura WEM ya instalada" (costo reducido, no cero). Recomendado suavizar a "aprovechando la infraestructura ya instalada" y citar Mercier.

evidencia_textual: "ARTIC RSV amplicon sequencing reveals global RSV genotype dynamics" (RSV_paper_Romel/Maloney, p.1); "11Institute of Microbiology, Universidad San Francisco de Quito, Quito, Pichincha, Ecuador" (Maloney, p.1); "Of the eight external sites four used Illumina platforms (CHRF, GSTT, USAF and UW) and four used Nanopore (MDH, NVRL, UoN and USFQ)" (Maloney, p.7)
refuerzo_pico: "For Nanopore, median genome completeness was 94.9% and 95.8% for RSV A and B respectively (RSVA, n = 107; RSVB, n = 99)." (RSV_paper_Romel/Maloney, p.4)
nota_contexto: El esquema ARTIC lo conceptualiza la red ARTIC (Rambaut A: Conceptualization/Resources, Edimburgo). USFQ figura como institucion coautora (afiliacion 11) y como uno de los cuatro sitios que secuenciaron con Nanopore, logrando 94,9%/95,8% de completitud. "Desarrollado con participacion de USFQ" sobreestima el rol; correcto: "esquema ARTIC aplicado y validado con Nanopore en un estudio del que USFQ es coautora".

evidencia_textual: "As global SARS-CoV-2 burden and testing frequency have decreased, wastewater surveillance has emerged as a key tool to support clinical surveillance efforts." (s41467-023-41369-5/Yousif, p.1)
refuerzo_pico: "As seen with unequal distribution of SARS-CoV-2 vaccines, unequal genomic surveillance in LMICs could jeopardize genomic sequencing efforts in developed countries." (bruno-2025, p.6)
nota_contexto: Yousif posiciona la vigilancia de aguas como complemento de la clinica; Bruno documenta la desigualdad de vigilancia genomica en LMIC. Contexto respalda la lectura poblacional complementaria ante informacion local limitada.

evidencia_textual: Titulo: "Wastewater-based surveillance as a tool for public health action: SARS-CoV-2 and beyond" (parkins-2023, p.1)
refuerzo_pico: "strategically implemented WBS sites in sentinel sewersheds would still have profound impacts in these resource-limited settings. In particular, WBS offers a cost-effective, real-time measure enabling an understanding of the local prevalence of individual infectious agents within these resource-constrained settings" (parkins-2023, p.39)
nota_contexto: Parkins enmarca la WBS como herramienta de accion en salud publica y, para entornos de recursos limitados, propone sitios centinela estrategicos para conocer la prevalencia local de agentes. Contexto respalda priorizacion/planificacion de vigilancia.

evidencia_textual: "Up to 1%-2% of infants under 6 months with RSV are hospitalized, and RSV is responsible for up to a third of hospitalizations for acute respiratory infections (ARI) in children less than 5 years old in the United States" (Hughes, p.1)
refuerzo_pico: Titulos: "Detection of circulating vaccine-derived poliovirus type 2 (cVDPV2) in wastewater samples: a wake-up call" (eurosurv-30-3-1/Bottcher, p.1); "Genome Sequencing of Sewage Detects Regionally Prevalent SARS-CoV-2 Variants" (crits-christoph-2021, p.1)
nota_contexto: Hughes cuantifica la carga de RSV en lactantes/ninos <5 anos; Bottcher documenta polio silencioso (cVDPV2 en aguas) y Crits variantes prevalentes en aguas. Contexto respalda a los grupos vulnerables y comunidades expuestas.

evidencia_textual: Antecedente local (00331348-MejiaCalle, p.8); "Environmental Surveillance for Polioviruses" (asghar-2014, p.1); RSV en aguas (Hughes, p.1); secuenciacion RSV con Nanopore/RSVTyper (s41598-025-20371-5/Le, p.1)
refuerzo_pico: "Genomic wastewater surveillance may therefore be plausible for a broad range of human pathogenic viruses, using similar methods to those deployed during the SARS-CoV-2 pandemic." (child-2023, p.2)
nota_contexto: Child sostiene que la vigilancia genomica de aguas es plausible para un amplio rango de virus con los metodos de la pandemia; los antecedentes de polio (Asghar) y RSV (Hughes, Le) respaldan la ampliacion desde SARS-CoV-2. Contexto respalda la idea.

evidencia_textual: "Phylogenetic analysis of complete VP1 sequences of viruses isolated from sewage samples in Mumbai and AFP cases" (asghar-2014, p.7)
refuerzo_pico: "To differentiate VDPV from Sabin OPV strains, allowing confirmation of a VDPV and consideration of a response, the approximately 900-bp VP1 capsid region must be sequenced." (jiab518/Shaw_2022, p.1)
nota_contexto: Asghar usa secuencias completas de VP1 desde aguas y Shaw explica que la region VP1 (~900 pb) es la que diferencia VDPV de Sabin. Contexto respalda la eleccion de VP1 como blanco de tipificacion del poliovirus.

evidencia_textual: "untargeted shotgun sequencing was unsuitable for genomic monitoring of the low virus concentrations in wastewater samples analyzed in this study." (child-2023, p.1)
refuerzo_pico: "Hybrid-capture enrichment represented a viable method for simultaneous genomic epidemiology of a range of..." virus (child-2023, p.1)
nota_contexto: Child muestra que la baja concentracion viral en aguas limita el shotgun no dirigido y favorece el enriquecimiento dirigido; el contexto respalda interpretar deteccion/caracterizacion segun posibilidades y limitaciones de la matriz ambiental.
